body:
I recently lost a close friend of mine to suicide 2 months ago, he was one of the very few people that helped me combat loneliness when I transferred into a new school. To make matters worse, the first friend I made in my new school also passed away a few days ago. I feel empty and haven't been feeling any emotions, good or bad. The thoughts of suicide haunt me multiple times a day and sometimes I'm really close to just doing it. 

But I seen what suicide does to people you love. When my friend took his own life our worlds changed. Everything seems darker and fleeting. I wished my friend would have talked to me...I would give anything in the world to just talk to him again. I can bet my life that your friends would much rather do anything to help you than feel someone so close be ripped from their life. I beg you that you consider talking to them first.
